claims.claim: Bought as brand new, working perfectly well
claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the fan powered on, spinning, or oscillating.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: No date code, box label, or receipt image provided to confirm purchase date or usage level.
Photos are static close-ups only; no operational test shown.
Interior of motor housing not visible in any photo.
Neither receipt nor warranty card appears in any of the four photos.

risks.risk: Fan may not power on or oscillate properly
risks.proof: Short video showing the fan plugged in, running on all speed settings, and oscillating.

risks.risk: Unknown true age and wear despite 'barely used' claim
risks.proof: Close-up photo of any date-of-manufacture sticker, plus photo of the actual receipt with date.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavily used, not near-new

risks.proof: Clear, legible close-up of the gold hub logo/badge or a nameplate on the base.

risks.risk: Motor noise or vibration issues not visible in stills
risks.proof: Audio-included video clip of the fan running for at least 30 seconds.

risks.risk: Missing remote or accessories if originally included
risks.proof: Photo of remote control or original accessory box contents, if any.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base unit only, no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or chips on blades/cage not caught by current angles
risks.proof: Full 360-degree photos including underside of base and blade edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced allowing for minor cosmetic damage

proof_requests: Video of the fan running, oscillating, and cycling through speed settings
Photo of the receipt and warranty card mentioned by the seller
Clear legible close-up of the brand logo/nameplate
Full 360-degree photos of blades, cage, and base including underside
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a standing/pedestal fan, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified condition, unknown brand, no proof of age) pending the listed proofs that could raise the price.
